newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 10yr Btp spread over Bund drops below 170bps.
newsitem.headline: Italy 10yr Btp spread over Bund drops below 170bps.

text.p: The spread of the yield on the 10-year Italian fixed rate government bond (Btp) over the yield on the benchmark 10-year Bund dropped below 170 basis points in late European trade.
The spread narrowed to 168 basis points, the lowest spread ever, from a record low of 171 basis points set on November 19 this year.
The benchmark Bund was yielding 5.88 percent while the 10-year Btp was yielding 7.58 percent by 1610 GMT.
